answer: Each AI grader joins the network by submitting a cryptographic proof that echoes a unique, time‑stamped challenge issued by a rotating inlet of validator nodes, tying its identity to a physical‑world credential stored in a distributed garden of attestations. Periodically a random jury of independent auditors selects a subset of these graders for spot‑check audits, recomputing the challenge‑response chain and comparing it against the garden ledger; any mismatch triggers immediate revocation and a slash of the grader’s stake.
